objetivo: Describe your current routine and compare weekdays and weekends.

memo.es: when you finish your job for the day

parejas.b: On weekdays, I start work at 8:00.

parejas.a: What time do you wake up?
parejas.b: At 6:30. I have breakfast and then I go to work.

parejas.a: What do you do after work?
parejas.b: I cook dinner and study English.

parejas.a: Is every weekday the same for you?
parejas.b: Yes, but on the weekend, I rest and spend time with my family.
